title: Login roles and accessible databases
description: Return grants only for roles with can_login = 1. Return exactly two columns: role_name, database_name, one row per grant. Sort by role_name ASC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT r.role_name, d.name AS database_name
FROM role_grants AS g
hints: Join role_grants to both db_roles and databases.
The can_login filter applies to the role row.
solution_explanation: Two foreign references in the grants table require two joins.
